prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” interior painter for all situations in St. Louis — the right company depends on your home, budget, timeline and quality expectations. I can, however, help you find the best one for your job. Before I dig into local options, here’s a quick plan and what to look for:

Questions I need
- Zip code or neighborhood in St. Louis
- Residential or commercial? (single room, whole house, condo, rental, etc.)
- Rough budget and desired timeline
- Any special needs (trim/woodwork, wallpaper removal, color consulting, eco‑friendly paints)

How to pick the best painter
- Read recent Google, Yelp and Angi/BBB reviews for trends (not just single 5-star or 1-star)
- Verify they’re insured and ask for proof of general liability + workers’ comp
- Get at least 3 written estimates with the same scope of work
- Ask about prep work (patching, sanding, priming), number of coats, paint brands and sheen
- Ask for references and recent photos of completed jobs similar to yours
- Confirm schedule, start/end date, clean-up plan and warranty/guarantee
- Prefer contractors who provide a written contract and payment schedule (avoid large upfront cash payments)

Key questions to ask a painting company
- What warranties do you offer?
- Who will be on site and are they employees or subcontractors?
- What brand and line of paint do you recommend, and why?
- How do you protect floors/furniture and repair mistakes?
- Can you provide references with similar projects?

Red flags
- No written estimate or contract
- Asks for large full payment up front
- Vague answers about prep work, number of coats or paint brand
- No proof of insurance or unwillingness to provide references

If you want, tell me your zip code and a bit about the job and I’ll pull together 3–5 highly rated local interior painters in St. Louis with links to reviews and contact info so you can compare estimates. Which area and what kind of job are you looking to have done?
